card.name: Talk about typed symbols and characters
card.fires_on: Words like symbol, character, punctuation or the mark itself, in text that describes a typographic sign such as an asterisk, cent sign or colon. It fires mostly in computing, spreadsheet and writing-style explanations.

modes.label: The word symbol
modes.description: The word symbol or symbols right after a sign's name, as in 'multiplication symbol'.
modes.example: The asterisk is the multiplication<< symbol>> in Excel.

modes.label: Character or punctuation words
modes.description: Words such as character or punctuation, or a listed mark, where text defines which signs are allowed or used.
modes.example: To print this<< character>> one could say $lcd->write_ascii

card.writes: It pushes the model to output the word symbol or symbols, or a similar word for a typed sign.
card.plain: It spots text that is explaining a typed sign, such as an asterisk or a cent sign, and expects the word symbol next.
